title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 11 Part 1, HYD-JUN - EB.9
text:
Heal bony, naked, rough, and furnished with futures:
teeth acute, and clude in the jaw and palates; two
beards at the nofs; gill membrane twelve-royed;
body faly.
